ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering COVID-19 Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the Feeding Our Future case and its connections to other COVID-19 fraud schemes
questions: What other COVID-19 fraud schemes are currently under investigation?
How much money has been lost to COVID-19 fraud?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a large-scale fraud scheme, and by analyzing data and public records, we can identify patterns and connections between entities.
